overview.title: Adaptation projects
overview.description: Pick a project to continue, or start a new one. Each project begins with imported source text and advances act by act to the adaptation report.
overview.empty: No projects yet. Click "New project" to start your first adaptation.

placeholder.note: This feature is still planned; the page is a routing-scaffold placeholder.

import.textPlaceholder: Paste this chapter. Keep one blank line between paragraphs.
import.deleteConfirm: Delete this chapter? This action cannot be undone.
import.empty: No chapters yet. Paste the first source chapter; at least 3 chapters are required before the understanding stage.
import.thresholdMet: The {{min}}-chapter threshold is met. You can continue.
import.titleNotPersistedHint: Chapter titles are not persisted by the backend yet; the list uses localized titles derived from chapter order.
import.paragraphSpacingHint: Keep a blank line between paragraphs to preserve source_ref granularity later.
import.uploadHint: Uploading only creates a preview. Confirming replaces all current chapters.
import.previewDescription: Review the split result. You can adjust titles and body text before confirming.
import.replaceWarning: Confirming import clears all current chapters and rebuilds source paragraphs from the preview.
import.editDescription: Saving re-splits paragraphs by blank lines and updates character counts.
import.splitDescription: Choose the paragraph where the new chapter starts.
import.splitAtDescription: Paragraph K becomes the first paragraph of the new chapter.
import.splitUnavailable: At least 2 paragraphs are required to split
import.mergeDescription: Merge keeps the first chapter id and rebuilds order from the backend response.

understanding.title: Work understanding
understanding.description: Generate the prerequisite understanding, then calibrate the storyline, themes, motivations, adaptation difficulty, and trust signals.
understanding.thresholdDescription: Work understanding requires at least {{min}} source chapters. Return to import and add more chapters first.
understanding.cardDescription: These fields become prerequisites for character profiles and downstream adaptation.
understanding.emptyDescription: Generate an editable work-understanding report from the imported chapters.
understanding.regenerateDescription: Regeneration replaces the current form with the backend result and returns the artifact to draft state.
understanding.reconfirmDescription: Editing a confirmed understanding returns it to draft on save. Confirm it again before continuing to character profiles.
understanding.trustDescription: These backend-inferred signals are read-only and preserved unchanged on save.
understanding.nonVisualizableEmpty: No non-visualizable content is marked yet.

placeholders.logline: Summarize the main line and core conflict in one sentence
placeholders.synopsis: Summarize the story path, key relationships, and emotional progression
placeholders.protagonist_goal: What the protagonist most wants to achieve
placeholders.protagonist_fear: What the protagonist most fears losing or facing
placeholders.central_conflict: The main conflict that supports adaptation
placeholders.style_fingerprint: Summarize the source voice and language texture

characters.title: Character profiles
characters.description: Character profiles are generated after understanding is confirmed and constrain downstream behavior, dialogue, and relationship changes.
characters.lockedDescription: The frontend locks this step for the P1 flow: continue only after the understanding artifact is confirmed.
characters.gateBlocked: The backend still requires confirmed understanding. Return to the previous step and confirm it first.
characters.cardDescription: Character profiles constrain downstream behavior, voice, and relationship changes.
characters.emptyDescription: Generate character profiles from the confirmed work understanding.
characters.regenerateDescription: Regeneration replaces all current characters and returns the profile artifact to draft state.
characters.deleteDescription: Deleting returns the profile artifact to draft state and requires reconfirmation.
characters.needsReconfirmDescription: Adding, editing, or deleting a character returns the artifact to draft. Confirm it again before continuing to author intent.
characters.idConflict: Character id already exists. Adjust the name and try again.

placeholders.name: For example: Lin Wan
placeholders.voice: For example: restrained, often answers with questions
placeholders.arc: Optional, for example: from avoidance to confrontation
placeholders.hard_rules: Enter a rule and add it
placeholders.relationChange: Optional, for example: from distant to reconciled

intent.title: Author intent & direction
intent.description: Author intent is filled after character profiles are confirmed and combined with adaptation direction for downstream conflict checks.
intent.lockedDescription: The frontend locks this step for the P1 flow: continue only after the character profile artifact is confirmed.
intent.gateNote: This is a frontend flow gate; the backend currently does not use project.gates for this step.
intent.cardDescription: Saving confirms author intent immediately; direction is stored separately in project metadata.
intent.emptyDescription: Fill preservation, deletion, merge, and allowed-change constraints for downstream outline and script generation.
intent.formDescription: These constraints capture the author's non-negotiable creative intent. Saving confirms the intent artifact immediately.
intent.directionDescription: Direction is stored in project metadata. Conflict validation reads both saved intent and the current direction.
intent.validationDescription: Conflicts warn but do not block; the author decides whether to adjust.
intent.validateFirst: Save intent and choose a direction first
intent.noConflictsDescription: The current intent and adaptation direction have no deterministic conflicts.
intent.conflictDescription: These conflicts do not block the next step; you decide whether to adjust.
intent.completeDescription: You can continue to the scene outline. The outline page may still be a placeholder, but navigation should remain available.

fieldDescriptions.keep: Plot points, relationships, or motifs that must be preserved.
fieldDescriptions.no_delete: Events, characters, or information that cannot be removed.
fieldDescriptions.no_merge: Items that cannot be merged with other material.
fieldDescriptions.must_keep_lines: Source lines that should be preserved or adapted in the script.
fieldDescriptions.mood_floor: The minimum emotional tone the adaptation must preserve.
fieldDescriptions.allow_new_plot: Allow new plot beats for screen adaptation.
fieldDescriptions.allow_reorder: Allow event reordering to improve pacing.
fieldDescriptions.allow_new_ending: Allow rewriting or intensifying the ending.

placeholders.keep: Enter a must-keep item and add it
placeholders.no_delete: Enter a do-not-delete item and add it
placeholders.no_merge: Enter a do-not-merge item and add it
placeholders.must_keep_lines: Enter a source line and add it
placeholders.mood_floor: For example: do not weaken the suspense or restraint

faithful.label: Faithful
faithful.description: Preserve the source structure, relationships, and ending as much as possible.

cinematic.label: Cinematic
cinematic.description: Strengthen visual action, rhythm, and staging while allowing moderate adaptation.

short_drama.label: Short drama
short_drama.description: Prioritize early hooks, sharp conflict, and fast pacing.

conflicts.faithful_vs_new_ending: Faithful adaptation conflicts with allowing ending changes.
conflicts.faithful_vs_new_plot: Faithful adaptation conflicts with allowing new plot beats.
conflicts.faithful_vs_reorder: Faithful adaptation conflicts with allowing reordering.
conflicts.short_drama_vs_no_reorder: Short drama mode usually needs reordering to strengthen early hooks.

outline.lockedDescription: Scene outline generation requires the character profile artifact to be confirmed. Return to character profiles and confirm them first.
outline.gateBlocked: The backend still requires confirmed character profiles. Return to character profiles and confirm before generating.
outline.emptyDescription: Generate a confirmable, source-traceable scene outline from the confirmed character profiles.
outline.cardDescription: {{count}} scenes. Each scene keeps heading, source, characters, goal, conflict, and relationship changes.
outline.regenerateDescription: Regeneration replaces all current scenes. If the outline is already confirmed, it returns to draft state.
outline.needsConfirmDescription: A draft outline cannot generate a screenplay yet. Confirm it to continue; later edits will return the outline to draft.
outline.confirmedDescription: You can continue to screenplay generation. The backend will use this outline as the prerequisite artifact.

merge.title: Merge suggestions
merge.description: Review backend suggestions for transitional scenes and mark your decision.
merge.guardrailDescription: These are suggestions only. Applying marks your decision; the system will not automatically merge or delete scenes. Use scene editing and deletion if you want to merge them manually.
merge.statusNotice: The scene structure is unchanged. Edit or delete scenes manually if needed.
merge.empty: No transitional merge suggestions right now.

edit.dialogDescription: Adding or editing a scene returns the outline to draft. Choose a real chapter and at least one source paragraph before saving.
edit.draftNotice: The outline is back in draft state. Confirm it again before continuing to screenplay generation.
edit.deleteDescription: Deleting removes this scene and returns the outline to draft. It will not automatically rewrite other scenes.
edit.invalidSourceRef: This scene has an invalid source reference. Choose a real chapter and at least one existing paragraph.
edit.sceneIdConflict: This scene id already exists. Reopen Add scene and save again.
edit.requiredFields: Fill location, synopsis, and at least one source paragraph.
edit.paragraphDescription: Only real paragraphs from the selected chapter are available, so backend source_ref validation can pass.
edit.characterDescription: Used for scene cast display and downstream screenplay generation.

placeholders.synopsis: Summarize what happens in this scene
placeholders.goal: What the character is trying to achieve
placeholders.conflict: The obstacle or conflict in this scene
placeholders.endingState: The new state at the end of this scene
placeholders.relationChange: For example: trust begins to crack

script.lockedDescription: Screenplay draft generation requires the scene outline artifact to be confirmed. Return to the outline step and confirm it first.
script.gateBlocked: The backend still requires a confirmed scene outline. Return to the outline step and confirm before generating.
script.emptyDescription: Generate a structured screenplay from the confirmed outline, including action, dialogue, subtext, source markers, and TODO blanks.
script.regenerateDescription: Regeneration overwrites the current screenplay content and keeps it in draft state.
script.cardDescription: {{sceneCount}} scenes, {{beatCount}} beats. This is a read-only structured viewer.
script.shotHintsDescription: Shot sizes and camera movement are generated as suggestions only. This switch only affects the current generation.

import.title: Import & Preprocessing
import.description: Paste or upload TXT/DOCX novels, split by chapter, and validate at least 3 chapters before continuing.

analysis.title: Understanding & Character Profiles
analysis.description: Generate editable story understanding, character profiles, author intent, and adaptation direction—understand first, then adapt.

outline.title: Scene Outline
outline.description: Generate a per-scene outline with source_ref bindings, then confirm it to unlock screenplay generation.

script.title: Screenplay Generation
script.description: Translate the outline into a YAML screenplay: externalization, dialogue scripting, added-content flags, and line-level sourcing.

editor.title: Editing Workbench
editor.description: Side-by-side source vs. screenplay, scoped regeneration, WYSIWYG editing, and TODO markers.

report.title: Adaptation Report
report.description: Summarize kept/cut/merged/added/externalized changes, consistent with screenplay flags, each traceable to the source.

settings.title: Project Settings
settings.description: Privacy and no-training commitment, shot-hint defaults, storage region, and other project-level settings.
